summary: Our project, "Earth vs Moon: Where Can Humans Survive?", compares Earth and the Moon to understand why Earth is suitable for human life while the Moon is not. It explores important factors such as air, water, temperature, gravity and living conditions. Through this project, we aim to discover the challenges humans would face when living on the Moon and understand the importance of protecting Earth.
details: Our project compares Earth and the Moon based on their environments and ability to support human life. It explores differences in atmosphere, water, temperature, gravity and living conditions. This project aims to help students understand why humans can survive naturally on Earth but need special equipment and technology to live on the Moon.
